proposed_facts: QIK-VRT is a repository-centered software system developed by Informatiker and Product Owner Ingolf Lohmann.
The repository contains Lean/Lake formalizations with a reproducible proof inventory, proof map, verification report and axiom audit.
The repository's Zero-Bug Continuous Invariant denotes a freshly evidenced exact repository state without known deterministic defects; it explicitly does not assert that unknown defects cannot exist.
QIK-VRT applies repository automation recursively to parts of its own development, review, evidence and reobservation process.
